summary: A number the user types or steps up and down, in a field with two small buttons.

min.description: The lowest value. With none, there is no lower limit.

max.description: The highest value. With none, there is no upper limit.

step.description: The distance between two values the user can reach.

disabled.description: The field cannot be changed or focused.

root.note: The field around the input and the two buttons. While the input is read-only it has the etched face and the buttons are hidden, in the same room.

input.note: A native text input the author writes and marks with data-part="input" (D14). It gets the spinbutton role and carries the form value under its own name.

decrease.note: One step down. Not a Tab stop: the keys do the same.

keys.Home, End: The minimum or the maximum, when there is one.

events.input: The input's own event, also dispatched after a step.
events.change: The input's own event, also dispatched after a step.

messages.rangeUnderflow: Enter a number of {min} or more.
messages.rangeOverflow: Enter a number of {max} or less.

guidance.text: Write readonly on the input to make the field read-only: the recipe reads it there, so the etched face and the hidden buttons show before the element is defined. The keys and the buttons then do not step. A disabled field wins over read-only.

notYet: A value that is not a plain number, such as a time.
Stepping faster while a button is held.
